title: Academic Programs & Innovation Manager
description:
In the role of the
 
**Program Manager, FORT.Academy** 

 the person shall report to the CEO, Forge and engage in a scope of work spanning techno\-managerial, financial, operational and administrative aspects relating to the broad
 
***Key Result Areas (KRAs)* 
 covering
 *program management \& operations of various offerings, Training services, Innovation Project Management services for MSMEs \& Startups, Partner/Client Stakeholder Management \& Ecosystem Connect, and General Administration.***





  






 FORT.Academy shall partner with various knowledge/capability partners, higher technical institutions and Industry partners (MSMEs and Startups) to implement the Innovation Practicum for Technical Education and Manufacturing Technology Practicum as an adjunct process to the academic curriculum, and as the consolidated process for all innovation centered initiatives, policies and programs at a national scale. The Program Manager is the operational lead for the MTP(Manufacturing Technology Practicum), requiring a high degree of organisational skill, attention to detail, and a deep understanding of the program's practical components. The role is a blend of administration, coordination, and participant\-facing support, ensuring that all program activities run smoothly and effectively.
 




  





**Introduction: FORT.Academy within Forge Innovation \& Ventures** 





 Forge Innovation \& Ventures operates as a vertically integrated enterprise, fundamentally committed to establishing and managing a national\-scale Open Innovation Value Network. The core objective of this network is to catalyse talent, technology, and ventures, thereby powering India's innovation economy in the Industrial Intelligence Age. The strategic framework of the organisation is meticulously structured around six Strategic Program Verticals (SPVs), each aligned with one of three core thrust areas: Talent, Technology, and Ventures.
 





 Forge.Academy is positioned as a core Strategic Program Vertical (SPV) under Forge's overarching "Talent" thrust area. Its primary function is to cultivate an innovation\-capable industrial workforce and entrepreneurial talent pool achieved through a comprehensive portfolio of university\-accredited/affiliated graduate education programs and professional development courses focused on innovation and entrepreneurship.
 




  






 FORT.Academy accelerates the convergence of industrial manufacturing with cutting\-edge technology, serving as the framework under which the Innovation Practicum for Technical Education and Manufacturing Technology Practicum for Industrial Workforce are implemented. Innovation Practicum for Technical Education is a unique program designed to redefine the role of an engineer by equipping students with a potent blend of technology, innovation, and entrepreneurial spirit necessary to tackle contemporary industry challenges. Manufacturing Technology Practicum operationalises the Manufacturing Technology Practicum as the cornerstone of the Career Advancement \& Capability Development (CACD) program, providing a structured pathway for the industrial workforce to evolve from being passive technology users to becoming active innovators, strategists, and leaders.
 




  





**Position \& Designation** 




**Grade \- Manager or Sr. Manager** 





 The
 
**Program Manager** 

 to be designated in Forge at the grade of Manager or Sr.Manager shall be considered for a promotion to the role of Business Manager after having delivered a commendable performance in the stated role for a minimum tenure of 24 months.
 




  





**Compensation** 





 Forge compensation is at par with the top end of the social enterprises sector in India and continuously benchmarked to be above the average compensation offered in the social (non\-commercial or development) sector in general but significantly above the average compensation offered by TBIs. The Total CTC will include 3 major components namely,
 
**Fixed Monthly Gross** 

 ,
 
**Fixed Quarterly Payout, and Annual Development Bonus** 

 (linked to demonstration of progress on developing and strengthening capabilities in alignment with the Career Advancement and Capabilities Development framework of Forge).
 




  





**Role \& Responsibilities \- Key Result Areas** 



1. **Program Delivery \& Operational Excellence**


* Lead the end\-to\-end execution of the MTP and all innovation programs, encompassing comprehensive logistical orchestration from inception to completion.
* Create and manage detailed course schedules while coordinating seamlessly with faculty, coaches, and external partners to guarantee timely availability of all facilities and resources.
* Ensure robust support for hands\-on lab sessions, practical exercises, and innovation projects, thereby elevating the quality of participant learning experiences and driving operational excellence
* Maintain a high degree of operational excellence directly correlates with participant satisfaction and successful learning outcomes.



**2\.Commercialisation, Revenue Scaling \& Innovation Leadership** 



* Support CEO and CPO Fort.Academy is actively prospecting, seeding, and nurturing opportunities for commercializing various knowledge products developed, standardized, and monetized under innovation programs.
* Support the CEO and CPO Fort.Academy, Fort.Academy to manage execution of initiatives or lead certain ones for scaling revenue generation from beneficiaries including industrial companies (corporates \& MSMEs), academia, industry professionals, and startups.
* Lead innovation skills training and competencies development programs, managing design, delivery, admissions, curriculum alignment, and operational aspects for future\-ready talent.
* Lead innovation projects and services, overseeing product innovations, structured processes, stakeholder management, trainee coaching, and outcome monitoring.



**3\.Participant Success \& Support** 



* Drive participant journeys from initial enrollment through career advancement, serving as the primary conduit for academic guidance while meticulously tracking progress against defined learning outcomes.
* Oversee comprehensive onboarding processes, infuse the human touch into addressing career goals, and nurture future\-ready talent in harmony with industrial digital transformation imperatives.innovation practicum got industrial innovation
* Act as a career advancement coach and innovation mentor for diverse trainees \- including students and professionals delivering personalized support on seamless program transitions, such as from GEC Level III to PGDTM, informed by individual performance and aspirations.
* Play a deeply personal role in guiding trainees through innovation lifecycles from challenge curation and solution exploration to product concept development and MUP design ensuring the tiered program structure empowers strategic missions with vital support.



**4\.Educational Infrastructure \& Resource Management** 



* Manage the  allocation, maintenance, and optimal utilization of all educational resources essential for the MTP and innovation programs.
* Ensure availability of lab equipment, software licenses for tools like CAD/CAM or PLC programming, classroom spaces, and inventory of consumables for uninterrupted hands\-on learning.
* Develop and manage necessary systems, processes, and tools to facilitate seamless knowledge sharing, program facilitation, and resource efficiency across physical, digital, and hybrid formats.
* Maintain all resources in prime working condition while working across Forge centers to support practice\-based, innovation\-centric learning models.



**5\.Team Staffing, Training \& Stakeholder Representation** 



* Staff, train, and manage a team of competent program leads and program associates apart from playing the role of the authorised representative of the company’s CEO to all external stakeholders in the respective program ecosystem.
* Foster internal and external stakeholder communication for streamlined project completion and ecosystem engagement.



**6\.Performance Monitoring \& Reporting** 



* Diligently collect, analyse, and report on a broad set of key performance indicators (KPIs) spanning program effectiveness, participant enrollment, completion rates, satisfaction scores, and innovation outcomes.
* Gather feedback on courses, faculty performance, and specific initiatives, consolidating data for the Program Director to fuel strategic decisions and continuous improvements.
* Monitor and report product innovation impacts, ensuring timely deployment of projects while demonstrating program value through meticulous metrics.



**7\.Program Operations, MarComm \& Ecosystem Engagement** 



* Lead/support the effective planning and implementation of events, conferences, visits, startup demos, ecosystem meetups, and other forms of physical, digital or hybrid events required towards creating a strong pipeline of talent and industry partners for the various innovation programs implemented by Fort.Academy
* Anchor the implementation of various activities and deliverables coming under the purview of Marketing Communications relating to outreach campaigns, event collateral, social media promotions etc.

 To ensure efficient administration of facilities, transport, canteen, contract workforce, security, GMP support, Contractor statutory compliance, audits, and employee services while maintaining operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and a safe, productive workplace environment.

* Coordinate with Lindstrom for gowning services and employee concerns.
* Ensure compliance with gowning and shoe\-washing procedures.

* Manage biometric hardware and software systems.
* Coordinate vendor support, issue resolution, procurement, and maintenance.
* Scrap Management
* Arrange transportation and disposal of scrap materials including general waste, metal, wood, and other waste streams.
* Training \& Employee Development
* Organize training programs for housekeeping, security staff, drivers, and contract employees.
* Prepare and execute administrative engagement calendars and compliance training plans.
* Security Management
* Recruit security personnel as needed.
* Ensure proper management of visitor control, gate passes (RGP/NRGP), and material movement records.
* Pest Control Management
* Ensure pest control activities comply with GMP requirements.
* Coordinate audits, maintain records, monitor pest control equipment, and address observations with engineering teams.
* Compliance \- Contract Labor and others
* Verify ESI/PF deductions, minimum wage implementation, salary payments, approved manpower strength, wage registers, and statutory compliance through vendor coordination.

title: Type Test Manager – HV Switchgear
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 The Type Test Manager will serve as the primary technical authority for the organization and execution of type tests for Gas\-Insulated Switchgear (GIS) and Air\-Insulated Switchgear (AIS) circuit breakers. This role spans the entire testing lifecycle—from initial planning and budget coordination to lab management and final documentation. The position will be a key technical liaison for Tendering and Project teams, ensuring products meet the highest international standards and customer expectations while overseeing mechanical test lab operations.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**
**Type Testing Excellence**
* Strategic Planning: Lead the coordination of type test activities for GIS and AIS products, including the development of comprehensive test programs and physical test layouts.
* External Liaison: Manage relationships with external test laboratories and witnessing agencies to secure quotations, schedule test slots, and ensure alignment on test protocols.
* End\-to\-End Execution: Oversee the internal supply chain for testing, including budget management, Bill of Materials (BOM) accuracy, production order releases, and logistics for test samples.
* Travel to Labs in India and Abroad
* Technical Compliance: Execute type tests in collaboration with witnessing agencies, ensuring all procedures adhere to international standards and internal quality requirements.
* Documentation \& Approval: Maintain meticulous, traceable type test records and reports. Provide technical clarifications to support customer approvals and queries.


**Lab Operations \& Strategic Management**

 Golden Coir Tufts is a manufacturing and export company based in Pollachi, India, specializing in private\-label coir, rubber, and hybrid entrance mats for global retail and brand partners. The company operates on a six\-acre integrated campus that brings together product development, printing, backing, finishing, inspection, and export packing. With an annual production capacity of around five million mats, Golden Coir Tufts supports large\-scale, high\-quality, and timely deliveries. **Role Description:** 




 The Manager – Purchase \& Procurement will be responsible for end\-to\-end procurement activities for Golden Coir Tufts’ manufacturing operations. The role will manage sourcing, supplier development, commercial negotiations, purchase planning and timely availability of raw materials, packaging materials, chemicals, consumables, engineering spares and other production requirements.
 



  





 The position will work closely with Production, Planning, Stores, Quality, Accounts and Management to ensure uninterrupted material availability while maintaining optimum inventory levels and procurement costs.
 



  





 Key responsibilities include supplier identification and evaluation, RFQ comparison, price and payment\-term negotiation, purchase order management, delivery follow\-up, alternate vendor development, supplier performance monitoring and cost\-reduction initiatives.
 



  





 The role will also monitor material requirements against production plans, lead times and inventory levels; address supplier quality or delivery issues; maintain approved vendor records; and ensure purchasing activities are accurately recorded through the company’s ERP system.
 



  





 The Manager will be expected to continuously identify opportunities for cost reduction, supplier consolidation, alternate sourcing, improved payment terms, reduced lead times and better procurement controls.
 



  





**Qualifications:** 




 \* 5\+ years of procurement/purchasing experience, preferably in a manufacturing environment.
 



 \* Strong experience in vendor development, RFQ comparison, commercial negotiation and supplier performance management.
 



 \* Experience procuring raw materials, chemicals, polymers/rubber/PVC\-related materials, packaging, consumables or engineering spares is advantageous.
 



 \* Strong understanding of MRP/material planning, stock levels, reorder planning and production\-driven procurement.
 



 \* Proven ability to negotiate pricing, credit/payment terms, MOQ, lead times and supply contracts.
 



 \* Experience working with ERP\-based purchasing, PO, GRN and inventory workflows.
 



 \* Strong Excel/data\-analysis capability for purchase\-price analysis, consumption trends and cost\-saving analysis.
 



 \* Experience handling supplier quality issues, shortages and urgent production requirements.
 



 \* Experience in an export\-oriented manufacturing company is preferred.

title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Détient globalement l'activité de contrôle de projet et définit des spécifications fonctionnelles cohérentes et des processus globaux communs pour la mise en œuvre des projets. Activités menées pour mieux comprendre ou répondre à terme aux attentes du client Exerce une influence sur les opérations département et est responsable de la planification et/ou de l'exécution. Ce rôle jouit d'une certaine autonomie, mais est axé sur l'exécution d'activités au sein d'une discipline opérationnelle couverte par les pratiques et procédures fonctionnelles standard. Un certain discernement peut être nécessaire, mais généralement dans le cadre d'une orientation.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**
* Apporte une expertise technique et développe des solutions techniques (configuration, estimation des performances, économie, etc.) dans le cadre du processus pré\-ITO (demande d'achat) tout en assurant l'interface avec l'équipe commerciale. Possède une compréhension approfondie des marchés pertinents et de la valeur économique des clients, ce qui contribue à des stratégies d'adjudication gagnantes. Pour inclure « ITO » : Analyse technique du besoin client : définition et optimisation des produits ; du cadre (description) ; du programme ; du schéma industriel ; des coûts, compte tenu des contrats et politiques internes ainsi que des procédures. Calcul des performances et de l'efficacité des installations, des systèmes et des équipements. Documentation des spécifications techniques et des éléments de coût pour les phases ultérieures d'exécution du contrat. Cela inclut également la partie OTR (« de la commande jusqu'au versement ») où les ingénieurs s'emploient à personnaliser les produits et à les implémenter en fonction des besoins spécifiques des clients.
* Développer une connaissance approfondie d'une discipline technique. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et une expertise technique acquise pour mettre en œuvre une politique/stratégie.
* Compréhension approfondie des principaux facteurs opérationnels ; utilise cette compréhension pour accomplir son propre travail. Compréhension approfondie de la manière dont le travail de sa propre équipe s'intègre aux autres équipes et contribue à son domaine.
* Fait preuve de discernement et est en capacité de proposer différentes solutions en dehors des paramètres définis, dans le cadre d'une orientation. Se fonde sur une expérience antérieure et la formation professionnelle pour résoudre des tâches simples. Possède les compétences techniques et l'esprit d'analyse nécessaires à la résolution de problèmes. Peut utiliser plusieurs sources internes en dehors de sa propre équipe pour prendre des décisions.
* Un poste à ce niveau est susceptible d'être un contributeur individuel, avec des compétences interpersonnelles éprouvées ou un People Leader capable d'embaucher et de développer des talents. Fournit des conseils informels aux nouveaux membres de l'équipe.


**Qualifications De Base**
* 
* Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis \- Ce rôle nécessite une expérience significative de la fonction et de la station de travail audio numérique. Connaissances de niveau équivalent à une licence dans une université accréditée (ou un baccalauréat avec une expérience dans un domaine pertinent).
* Pour les rôles aux États\-Unis \- Licence d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 4 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).


**Caractéristiques souhaitées**
* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité à influencer les autres et à diriger de petites équipes. Mener des initiatives d'envergure et d'impact modérés. Capacité à coordonner plusieurs projets simultanément. Identification efficace des problèmes et compétences en résolution de problèmes. Capacités d'analyse et d'organisation prouvées.Remarque : Pour se conformer aux exigences légales américaines en matière d'immigration et autres, il est nécessaire de préciser le nombre minimum d'années d'expérience requis pour tout poste basé aux États\-Unis. Pour les rôles en dehors des États\-Unis, pour assurer la conformité avec la législation applicable, les juristes doivent mentionner le niveau d'expérience requis et non PAS un nombre minimum d'années.Cette description de poste a pour but de fournir un guide détaillé du rôle. Toutefois, il n'est pas prévu de modifier ou de restreindre et/ou d'élargir de quelque manière que ce soit les tâches requises de chaque employé, telles qu'elles sont définies dans leur contrat de travail respectif et/ou convenues d'un commun accord entre un employé et son responsable.

title: Lead Engineer - Customer Application Engineering
description:
**Job Description Summary**
 Verantwortung für die globale Projektsteuerungsaktivität und Förderung einheitlicher Funktionsspezifikationen und gemeinsamer globaler Prozesse für die Projektimplementierung. Tätigkeiten, die dazu dienen, die Erwartungen des Kunden besser zu verstehen oder letztendlich zu erfüllen Beeinflusst den Abteilungsbetrieb und ist verantwortlich für die Planung/Ausführung.Die Rolle hat eine gewisse Autonomie, konzentriert sich jedoch auf die Ausführung von Aktivitäten innerhalb einer operativen Disziplin, die durch funktionale Standardpraktiken und \-verfahren abgedeckt wird.Möglicherweise ist ein gewisses Urteilsvermögen erforderlich, dies erfolgt jedoch in der Regel unter Anleitung.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten**
* Bietet technisches Know\-how und entwickelt technische Lösungen (Konfiguration, Leistungsschätzung, Wirtschaftlichkeit usw.) im Rahmen des Pre\-ITO\-Prozesses (Beschaffung), und fungiert gleichzeitig als Schnittstelle zum kaufmännischen Team. Verfügt über fundiertes Wissen über die relevanten Märkte und des wirtschaftlichen Werts der Kunden, was zur Gewinnung von Gebotsstrategien beiträgt. Einschließen von "ITO": Technische Analyse des Kundenbedarfs: Definition und Optimierung der Produkte; Umfang (Beschreibung); Zeitplan; industrielle Regelung; Kosten unter Berücksichtigung der vertraglichen und internen Richtlinien und Verfahren. Berechnung der Leistung und Effizienz von Anlagen, Systemen und Ausrüstung. Dokumentation von technischen Spezifikationen und Kalkulationselementen für weitere Phasen der Vertragsabwicklung. Dazu gehört auch der OTR\-Teil, in dem die Ingenieure daran arbeiten, die Produkte anzupassen und für bestimmte Kundenanforderungen umzusetzen
* Vertiefung der Kenntnisse einer technischen Disziplin.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und erworbenes technisches Fachwissen, um Richtlinien/Strategien umzusetzen.
* Fundiertes Verständnis der wichtigsten Geschäftstreiber; nutzt dieses Verständnis, um eigene Arbeit zu leisten.Vertiefte Kenntnisse darüber, wie sich die Arbeit des eigenen Teams in andere Teams integriert und zum Bereich beiträgt.
* Verwendet ein gewisses Maß an Urteilsvermögen und hat die Fähigkeit, verschiedene Lösungen außerhalb der festgelegten Parameter vorzuschlagen, aber mit Anleitung.Verwendet vorherige Erfahrung und die Ausbildung am Arbeitsplatz, um einfache Aufgaben zu lösen.Hat Zugriff auf die technischen Fähigkeiten und das analytische Denken, die zur Lösung von Problemen erforderlich sind.Kann mehrere interne Quellen außerhalb des eigenen Teams verwenden, um Entscheidungen zu treffen.
* Eine Stelle auf dieser Ebene ist wahrscheinlich ein einzelner Mitarbeiter mit nachgewiesenen zwischenmenschlichen Fähigkeiten oder Führungsnachwuchs, der Talente einstellen und entwickeln kann.Bietet informelle Anleitung für neue Teammitglieder


**Grundqualifikationen**
* Diese Rolle erfordert fortgeschrittene Erfahrung. Der Wissensstand ist vergleichbar mit einem Bachelor\-Abschluss einer akkreditierten Universität oder Hochschule (oder einem Abitur mit relevanter Erfahrung).


**Gewünschte Eigenschaften**
* Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten. Ausgeprägte Sozialkompetenz und Führungsqualitäten. Fähigkeit, andere zu beeinflussen und kleine Teams zu führen. Initiativen von mittlerem Umfang und mittlerer Wirkung leiten. Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte gleichzeitig zu koordinieren. Effektive Erkennung und Lösung von Problemen. Nachweisliche analytische und organisatorische Fähigkeiten.Hinweis:Um die Einwanderungsbestimmungen der USA und andere gesetzliche Anforderungen zu erfüllen, muss die Mindestanzahl der Jahre an Erfahrung angegeben werden, die für eine Tätigkeit in den USA erforderlich sind.Für Rollen außerhalb der USA sollten sich die JDs auf das für die Rolle erforderliche inhaltliche Erfahrungsniveau konzentrieren, um die Einhaltung der geltenden Rechtsvorschriften zu gewährleisten, und eine Mindestanzahl von Jahren sollte NICHT verwendet werden.Diese Stellenbeschreibung soll einen allgemeinen Leitfaden für die Rolle liefern.Sie soll jedoch nicht die von jedem Mitarbeiter gemäß dem jeweiligen Arbeitsvertrag und/oder gemäß einer anderweitigen Vereinbarung zwischen einem Mitarbeiter und seinem Vorgesetzten geforderten Pflichten ändern oder anderweitig einzuschränken/erweitern.

title: Quality Manager
description:
**About The Role**
 As Quality Manager, you lead the plant quality function to deliver zero\-defect manufacturing, exceed customer expectations, and ensure compliance with OEM, IATF, and regulatory standards. You drive a culture of continuous improvement by leveraging robust quality systems, data\-driven decision\-making, and disciplined problem\-solving. Through strong leadership and collaboration across manufacturing, engineering, supplier quality, and customer teams, you enable operational excellence in quality performance and customer satisfaction while developing a high\-performing quality organization.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the site quality function to consistently achieve world\-class quality performance, customer satisfaction, and compliance with OEM and industry standards.
* Champion zero\-defect manufacturing by driving proactive quality planning, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement initiatives across welding and assembly operations.
* Lead customer quality management activities, including customer complaints, audits, issue resolution, and timely closure of corrective actions.
* Ensure effective implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System (QMS) in compliance with IATF 16949, ISO standards, and customer\-specific requirements.
* Drive defect reduction initiatives through structured problem\-solving methodologies and implementation of Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) reduction strategies.
* Oversee Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), Production Part Approval Process (PPAP), Process Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (PFMEA), Statistical Process Control (SPC), Measurement System Analysis (MSA), Control Plans, and implementation of 7QC tools.
* Lead root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes, and systematic containment activities for internal and external quality concerns.
* Partner with manufacturing, engineering, maintenance, supplier quality, and customer teams to resolve quality issues and improve process capability.
* Establish and monitor quality KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems to drive accountability and visibility across the organization.
* Develop and coach a high\-performing quality team, fostering technical excellence, ownership, and continuous learning.
* Ensure compliance with all safety, environmental, regulatory, and customer requirements while promoting operational discipline and best practices.


**Job Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Production Engineering, Automobile Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 15\+ years of experience in Quality Management within a Tier\-1 automotive manufacturing environment.
* Strong expertise in welding and assembly manufacturing processes and quality management systems.
* Proven experience in customer quality management, audit management, complaint handling, and corrective action implementation.
* Demonstrated knowledge and practical application of IATF 16949, APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plans, and core quality tools.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with experience driving defect reductionand continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience leading cross\-functional teams and influencing stakeholders to achieve quality and business objectives.
* Proficiency in interpreting customer requirements, regulatory standards, and quality system expectations.
* Effective communication, coaching, and leadership skills with a strong ownership mindset and customer focus.
* Relevant quality certifications and automotive quality credentials are preferred.
